notes: US 708: included as follow_up because Geier et al. (2015) previously studied it as one of the fastest unbound stars (T:p2-b4), and this paper directly compares its DDet donor models with it (T:p2-b5). The paper questions whether a viable DDet progenitor can reproduce its observed properties and velocity (T:p10-b6), but this does not revoke its previously established Galactic-unbound candidacy.

US 708: The paper reports US 708's observed spatial/travelling velocity of approximately 1,200 km/s in T:p2-b4 and T:p7-b9, attributed to Geier et al. (2015). It does not report US 708 coordinates, distance, parallax, proper motions, a line-of-sight radial velocity, galactocentric radius, or a numerical bound/unbound probability. Other quoted stellar parameters for US 708 (e.g., effective temperature, surface gravity, luminosity) are not among the extractable quantity identifiers.
